title: One Piece Has Confirmed Brook as the Most Tragic Straw Hat
content: One Piece is continuing the Elbaph arc with the release of new chapters, and in the past few chapters, the series has surprisingly dived into Brook’s past and seemingly confirmed that he is the most tragic Straw Hat.
author: ComicBook

title: Fox Corporation to Acquire Roku
content: Through the acquisition, the companies aim to increase scale and reach, expand their position in high growth of connected television, create a more powerful streaming platform. and enhance their long-term growth profile.
author: ANN

title: Surprise Crunchyroll Fantasy Isekai Returns for Season 2 After 2 Years (First Look Released)
content: Crunchyroll has a ton of new anime to look forward to through the rest of the year, and now that includes one surprising fantasy series that has confirmed it’s going to return for a second season after two years away.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Accidentally Reveals Final Season Release Date, Fans Claim
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has yet to officially confirm a release date for the anime’s final season, but fans claim that the date has been accidentally revealed much earlier than expected with a mysterious update.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Confirms Its Early Release Date (But There’s a Catch)
content: Black Clover is officially making its return with Season 2 of the anime later this year, and a few lucky fans will be able to catch the premiere episode much earlier than expected.
author: ComicBook

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Episode 11 Preview Spotlights Toshiro Dogo
content: MARRIAGETOXIN anime revealed the Episode 11 preview images and synopsis ahead of the episode’s June 16 release. Studio BONES Film is handling the animation production, which premiered on April 3 . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: HIDIVE to Stream I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Anime
content: The anime will premiere in October. The main cast members are: • Rei Takano as Amona • Yūki Nishiyama as Roni • Hōden Tei Senmai as Imp Seiya Miyajima ( Umayon , BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! Pico ) is directing as well as overseeing and writing the series scripts.
author: ANN

title: 2025 Spy×Family Stage Musical Gets Paid Streaming Outside Japan With English Subtitles
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the stage musical based on Tatsuya Endō 's SPY×FAMILY manga announced on Monday that the play's Nagoya run on December 29-30 last year will stream outside Japan with English subtitles on July 6. Performance replay will be available from July 7-20.
author: ANN

title: Liar Game Anime Casts Jun Fukuyama as Nearco
content: The official website for the television anime of Shinobu Kaitani 's Liar Game manga announced on Tuesday that Jun Fukuyama plays Nearco, who oversees the "Contraband Game." The game and character appeared in the 11th episode on Monday: REMOW introduces the series' story: A Mysterious Invitation.
author: ANN

title: 10/10 Sci-Fi Classic Anime Reboot Drops New Trailer Ahead of July Premiere
content: Ghost in the Shell is coming back to screens with a whole new anime reboot this Summer, and fans have gotten a new look at what to expect with a fresh trailer ahead of its premiere this July.
author: ComicBook
